title: Exactly what we needed
body: We needed to make checklists without fuss - at first I thought I wanted have the dance calendar integrations and task lists. But this is actually what we needed. Super flexible. Fun to use. Formatted for an iPad OR a phone. Accessible by anyone safely and easily. And everything is easy. Obvious. With exceptional customer service to boot. Count me in! We paid full price on the subscription, and will happily do it annually - we will be using this for years.
author: Jt808
